display_name: 已知仿真信道下的条件高斯信号先验诊断
description: 使用源训练干净IQ和冻结 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 高置信伪类别拟合类别条件高斯先验，在已知仿真信道和噪声协方差的不可部署假设下比较条件恢复与共享恢复。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI GPU0, one source-only diagnostic, float32 CUDA TF32 disabled; CPU 2 threads

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ float32 [2,256], cached simulation action and plug-in noise covariance; known action available only in diagnostic
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX labels, U_s truth, V or test read; clean Tri-SIG-TIME SSL predictions are pseudo categories
data.validation_ref: 384 RX8 day3 source heldout IDs, 64 per impaired scene; previously seen in other source views, not independent blind
data.leo_config_ref: Source train clean records and fixed cache epoch19 known simulated actions

permissions.query_use: Source-only diagnostic, no V, test IQ, target truth, or target predictions
permissions.claim_scope: Oracle known action and conditional-on-clean class are not deployable, no independent-blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; 8192 disjoint source train IQ examples fit global and six pseudo-class Gaussian priors; DURA loaded after prior fit only for same-record comparator.
